notes.title: May 30 2019 Update
notes.content:
1.Lower down pure ranking board unlock condition.
2.Big optimized select song performance.
3.Remake all hit effect.
4.Add replay feature, now all record on the ranking board can be watch by others.
5.Changes default UI to select song ui, also, you can change default ui to room in room settings.
6.Fixed one latency setting bug.
7.Optimized touch experience for touch screen
8.Add pre judge effect to Hex mode.
9.Remove bad keysound for some beatmaps.
10.Add one new free bundled song-一秩思归

notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
2018.03.28
Add input device latency setting.
Add filter to workshop page
Fixed minor bugs

2018.03.20
Game:
Fixed one of songs have overlaped notes
Fixed minor bugs

Rhythm Map Editor:
Improved user experience of Editor
Changes offset to global, now offset adjusting is more flexible
Add import bms support(should pack as zip first)


2018.03.16
1.Add Straight line judge mode, now you can switch between Straight track and Curved Track.
2.Steam Workshop is built into the game, players can upload self-made beatmaps and download beatmaps from other players.(PS.You will need to unlock "Custom Beatmap Library")
3.Rhythm Map Editor now can be opened directly from select song page.
4.Optimized hit experience, more friendly to PC players.
5.Optimized Hex mode, hit zone become 3 times larger.
6.Narrow track for Keyboard and Controller players.
7.Optimized performance, rendering quality and sounds.
8.Fixed minor bugs.

Special thank for players that provide opinions and feedback to us, we will try our best to do better.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
2018.03.15
Big Update!!!
Add new Straight track skin
Add Blend/Straight track and Speed adjustment to select song page
Rhythm Beatmap Editor new change ratio feature
Optimized some UI

2018.03.10
Rewrite Audio engine, now note display will be more smooth and compatible will be better
Optimized hex mode for keyboard and controller user
Optimzied effect
Fixed minor bugs

2018.03.04
Fixed bug that this in some machine only produce noise 

2018.03.02
Optimized manage song page
Optimized track for keyboard and controller user
Fixed minor bugs

2018.03.01
Workshop is coming!!!
Now you can subscribe song packs in game directly.
You can also upload and share self-made beatmaps to others in game directly.
RhythmMapEditor can now delete note by short-cut(CTRL+D or DELETE)
RhythmMapEditor's thunder note now can be placed with any direction
Fixed some RhythmMapEditor bugs
Fixed "Let's Go" get a note from beginning.
Fixed minor bugs.

2018.02.25
Add Quit button to start menu
Add multi-key(up to 3 keys) setting support for each single hex note
RhythmMapEditor will now run in windowed mode by default
Fixed minor bugs

2018.02.21
Optimized high keycount beatmap note display.
Fixed minor bugs

2018.02.20
Add upload feature to Rhythm Map Editor, now you can upload song packs to Steam workshop and share song packs to others
Fixed unlock custom song library achievent won't unlocked bug

2018.02.17
Fixed bug when importing beamaps key count more than 5
